description: Build proxy lines for one product, with optional location targeting and sticky sessions. Rotating lines get a new IP on every request; each sticky line keeps one IP for sticky_minutes (1-120). The lines include the proxy password.

asn.description: Carrier or ISP network number (ASN), digits only. Needs country.

count.description: Number of sticky lines, each with its own IP (rotating returns one line)

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. us. Leave every location field empty to use the targeting saved in the dashboard.

format.description: url: protocol://user:pass@host:port. host:port:user:pass: the colon format many tools import

session.description: rotating: a new IP on every request. sticky: each line keeps one IP for sticky_minutes

state.description: State or region, e.g. california. Needs country.

sticky_minutes.description: How long each sticky line keeps its IP

zip.description: ZIP or postal code. Needs country.

name: generate_proxies
title: Generate proxy lines
